finalSummary: opum-marketplace joins the fleet operating block as the eighth repository, per orchestrator go-ahead (opum-agent OPAG-61) after opum-doc's canonical record landed at dffaa21. Propagated the byte-identical v8 block (added row after quest-web) and updated EXPECTED_DIGEST to 5e543eb84584c382 in prepublication-qualification.yml. Verified before committing: diff against opum-doc's canonical block showed only the one added row; digest recomputed locally with CI's exact extraction (awk between the opum:fleet-operating markers | sha256sum | cut -c1-16) matched 5e543eb84584c382 before commit. Landed via PR #280, squash-merged to dev at 7d60289, all checks green (source-gates, operating block digest, and the full six-platform matrix build both required checks and the pushed workflow-file matrix build). Also checked whether the workflow's drift-error strings still hardcoded a stale repo count (opum-agent flagged this as OPAG-61's last criterion, citing PR #276/OPAG-58 as precedent) - they do not: #276 already generalized that message to fleet-generic wording with no number at all, so there was nothing left to correct.
